Atelier Ayesha - The Alchemist of Dusk.name: Atelier Ayesha: The Alchemist of Dusk
Atelier Ayesha - The Alchemist of Dusk.summary: The promise begins. The first entry in the Atelier "Dusk" series. Ayesha goes on a journey to find her missing sister. Learn the truth behind alchemy and the glowing flowers in the land of Dusk within 3 in-game years. This entry introduces an order-sensitive Synthesis system where players can expect to constantly recheck the steps until they reach a satisfactory predicted result, as well as a positional Turn-based Battle system where players can use "AC Support" depending on party members' position in combat.

Matching Maker 4.name: Machi-ing Maker 4
Matching Maker 4.summary: Machi-ing Maker 4 is a Strategy game, developed and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2011.

Need for Speed - ProStreet.name: Need for Speed: ProStreet
Need for Speed - ProStreet.summary: Compete at the highest level of street racing with Need for Speed ProStreet. It’s no longer good enough to simply rule your local neighborhood; you need to dominate on a global stage. Build the ultimate battle machine, take it to multi-disciplinary showdowns and pit your skills and reputation against the world’s best street racers.

Order Up!!.name: Order Up!!
Order Up!!.summary: In Order Up!!, players get to experience the dizzying life of a top-notch chef and restaurateur as they prepare all types of food, serve hordes of demanding patrons, and build their own restaurant empire from the ground up. Beginning in the world of fast food, new cooks must prove themselves by serving up quality dishes in the time allotted. As they master the basic skills and serve up tasty dishes using precision and time management skills, they will earn more money and move from fast food to five-star!

SingStar Afrikaanse Treffers.name: SingStar: Afrikaanse Treffers
SingStar Afrikaanse Treffers.summary: Localized release exclusive to South Africa. The game gives points which are distributed by the purity of singing, as in how well does one manage to stay on tune. It doesn't matter if you change octaves in the middle of the song or what words are you singing in (it doesn't have a word recognition), so your singing is rated by how well you manage to hit the correct note at the correct time.
